mail.subject: Moodboard for the spring issue
mail.text:
Hi!

I've pulled together a first moodboard for the spring issue: soft greens, a lot of paper texture, and the photos from the botanical garden shoot.

Could you take a look before Thursday? I'd like to settle the palette before we brief the illustrators.

Mira

mail.subject: Flat viewing on Saturday
mail.text:
The agent confirmed 11:30 on Saturday. It's the one with the big kitchen window and the balcony over the courtyard.

Coffee nearby afterwards, to talk it over?

T.

mail.subject: Re: Team offsite: three options
mail.text:
The mill gets my vote: big tables, good light, and a path along the river for the lunch walk.

The observatory would make a great evening, though.

Jonah

mail.subject: Your tickets for Friday, 18:40
mail.text:
Your booking is confirmed.

Coach C, seats 41 and 42

Show the code in the app at the gate, or print this message.

mail.subject: Team offsite: three options
mail.text:
Hi all,

I've shortlisted three places for the offsite: a farmhouse by the lake, a converted mill in the hills, and the old observatory in town.

All three take twelve people. Prices and photos are in the shared folder. Which one gets your vote?

Lena

mail.subject: Your order is on its way
mail.text:
Good news: your order has left the shop.

1 × A Field Guide to Clouds
1 × The Little Book of Bread

It should be with you within two working days.

mail.subject: The cake you asked about
mail.text:
Here's the lemon and thyme cake from Sunday.

200 g flour, 180 g sugar, 3 eggs, the zest of two lemons and a spoonful of fresh thyme. About 40 minutes at 175 °C.

The secret is the syrup: lemon juice and honey, poured over while the cake is still warm.

P.

mail.subject: Slides for Monday
mail.text:
The slides for Monday's review are in the shared folder. The numbers on page 6 still need your eyes; the rest is ready.

Lena

mail.subject: A book you reserved is ready
mail.text:
The book you reserved is waiting for you at the front desk:

Rivers of the North

We'll keep it for you for seven days.

mail.subject: Night walks, slow bread and a map of quiet places
mail.text:
This week:

- Why a walk after dark feels twice as long
- A loaf that takes two days and five minutes of work
- Twelve quiet places to read in the city, on one map

Enjoy the weekend.

mail.subject: Photos from the ridge walk
mail.text:
Finally sorted the photos from the ridge walk. The one with the fog rolling over the valley is my favourite.

The whole album is in the shared folder.

mail.subject: Welcome to the Thursday evening course
mail.text:
Thank you for signing up for the Thursday evening course.

We start at seven. Aprons and clay are on us; bring something to carry your first bowl home in.

See you there.

mail.subject: Numbers for the quarterly review
mail.text:

Theo
